query: SK Hynix Q2 2026 earnings release date confirmed - when will SK Hynix report second quarter 2026 results? Check Investor Relations calendar and DART filings for July 2026 date.
answer:
**SK Hynix Q2 2026 earnings release date is CONFIRMED: July 29, 2026 at 09:00 KST (Seoul Time).**

This is verified by SK Hynix's own regulatory filings, both dated July 15, 2026:
- **DART filing** (Korea's Financial Supervisory Service) — official IR disclosure announcing the conference call and live webcast
- **SEC Form 6-K** — confirming the same July 29, 2026, 9:00 a.m. Seoul Time call (SK Hynix's first earnings report after its Nasdaq ADR debut)

The report covers Q2 2026 (quarter ending June 30, 2026), with an IR conference call, live webcast in Korean and English, and Q&A. Materials will be posted on the company's IR website that day.

One minor caveat: a few aggregators (e.g., Moomoo) listed July 28 as an *estimate*, but this is superseded by the official filings confirming **July 29, 2026**.
